items.desc: The Presets are Australian electronic music royalty. From their beginnings as classically trained percussion students at the Sydney Conservatorium of Music to their breakthrough as synth-wielding dancefloor destroyers, Julian Hamilton and Kim Moyes have spent three decades making music that refuses to sit still. Their 2008 album Apocalypso made them the first electronic act to win the ARIA for Album of the Year, and singles like "My People" became anthems for a generation. Before The Presets, there was Prop: a minimalist percussion ensemble blending Steve Reich with spacey synths. The transfo…

items.desc: Legendary Brisbane band Powderfinger broke the internet when they announced a long-awaited reunion tour. The band sold out 26 shows across the country, and today announced extra shows, new cities, and an epic line-up of all-Australian support acts. Joining them on the road next year will be bands like Violent Soho, Thelma Plum, Ball Park Music, You Am I, Something For Kate, The Living End, John Butler Trio, Teen Jesus and the Jean Teasers + more. Bernard Fanning and Darren Middleton joined Zan Rowe to talk about what prompted the reunion, and how they feel about being back on stage next year.…
items.title: Powderfinger on their sold out reunion tour, adding extra shows & epic support acts

items.desc: Take 5 is turning 20! It started back in 2006 as a weekly radio segment on triple j, and since then it's grown into an award-winning podcast, and a beloved TV show in its sixth season. The list of people who have graced the Take 5 is epic: Lorde, Jack Antonoff, Kevin Bacon, Paul Kelly, Mel C from the Spice Girls, Bernard Fanning, there's even been a Beatle (Sir Paul McCartney!). To mark this special 20th anniversary, Zan Rowe has dug into some old shoe boxes and dusted off minidiscs and DAT tapes to bring to you a selection of vintage Take 5s. These special episodes haven't been heard by anyo…
items.title: 20th anniversary special: Calvin Harris, Annie Mac, Aloe Blacc & more

items.desc: Pia Miranda is joy personified. From her first TV gig on Neighbours, where her character Karen dated Toadie and made a dramatic final exit from the show holding a pavlova, to her breakthrough turn as Josie in Looking for Alibrandi, she has been one of Australia's most beloved screen actors for 25 years. But it's her second act that's surprised everyone, including herself: winning Australian Survivor in a unanimous vote, singing in a thong costume (the footwear kind) on The Masked Singer, and now co-hosting ABC TV's Recipe of the Year. items.desc: Take 5 is celebrating 20 years, and we're marking the milestone with something special. Zan Rowe is bringing the show to record stores around the country for four intimate, live conversations with some of Australia's most loved artists: The Presets Kate Miller-Heidke Dan Sultan John Butler Each guest takes on a theme and chooses five songs that speak to it, and what unfolds is always unexpected. All four live Take 5s will drop right here on the pod throughout November as part of Aus Music Month.
